story_fr: Skyrizi a depasse 5 Md$ de ventes nettes mondiales sur un seul trimestre au Q4 2025, devenant le premier produit du groupe et confirmant le relais de croissance post-Humira.
story_en: Skyrizi topped $5B in global net revenues in a single quarter in Q4 2025, becoming the group's top product and confirming the post-Humira growth relay.

story_fr: Le portefeuille Immunologie a atteint 30,406 Md$ sur l'exercice 2025, en hausse de 14,0 %, porte par Skyrizi et Rinvoq qui compensent largement l'erosion d'Humira.
story_en: The Immunology portfolio reached $30.406B for full-year 2025, up 14.0%, driven by Skyrizi and Rinvoq more than offsetting Humira erosion.
quote: Full-Year Global Net Revenues from the Immunology Portfolio Were $30.406 Billion, an Increase of 14.0 Percent on a Reported Basis
